name: Rapport, Inc
old_description: Since 1979, Rapport, Inc. has been providing electronic manufacturing services (EMS). Since 1993, we have focused our manufacturing efforts on providing custom cable and wire harnesses built to your specifications, to a world-wide customer base.
about:
Rapport, Inc. was founded in 1979 in Golden, Colorado. The company began as a provider of electronic manufacturing services (EMS) and later narrowed its focus to custom cable and wire harness assemblies in 1993.

Today Rapport offers a range of EMS capabilities including custom cable and wire harness fabrication, custom battery pack assembly, and bulk battery distribution. The company employs Kanban and just-in-time (JIT) inventory methods, documented quality procedures with internal and external audit compliance, and structured materials management such as scheduled production releases and safety stock services. Its production lines accommodate both prototype and high-volume runs, though specific facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Rapport serves a global customer base across industries that require UL/CSA compliance and RoHS adherence, including original equipment manufacturers and other electronics firms. The company’s acquisition of Car-Go Battery Company in 2012 expanded its wholesale battery offerings.

Rapport emphasizes cost savings through efficient processes and long-term partnerships. Its stated mission is to act as a strategic manufacturing partner, allowing customers to focus on core competencies while Rapport handles component, battery, and cable assembly needs. The company highlights its use of Kanban and JIT to improve throughput and delivery timelines, as well as its ISO 9001:2015 certification and adherence to UL/CSA and RoHS standards as differentiators.
